author: mia
title: Nyxa app update brings Face ID log-in and faster bet slips
dek: Version 4.12 of the Nyxa app also fixes a crash on older Android phones.
body:
Nyxa has released version 4.12 of its betting app for iPhone and Android. The update adds Face ID and fingerprint log-in and a redesigned bet slip that the company says loads faster. It also fixes a crash on older Android phones that users had been reporting for several weeks.

What is new in 4.12

  • Biometric log-in: Face ID on iPhone and fingerprint or face unlock on Android replace the four-digit PIN for customers who switch it on.
  • Faster bet slip: the slip has been rebuilt and, according to Nyxa, opens in under half a second on recent phones.
  • Clearer live prices: price changes in live markets are now highlighted for two seconds, so customers can see when odds move before they confirm.
  • Android fix: a crash when opening live markets on Android 9 devices has been resolved.

How biometric log-in works

Biometric log-in uses the phone's own security system. The app never receives your face or fingerprint data; it only receives a yes or no from the phone. Customers still need their password to change account details, add a bank account or withdraw for the first time to a new destination.

Nyxa says the feature is off by default. It can be switched on in Settings, under Security, after logging in with a password once.

The Android crash

Since late September, a number of customers on older Android phones reported that the app closed when they opened a live match. The fault affected devices running Android 9, which still make up a small share of Nyxa's Australian users. The company says the problem came from a graphics component in the live-score panel and has been replaced in this release.

Customers who are still affected after updating are asked to clear the app's cache or reinstall it.

What did not change

The update does not change account limits, payment methods or withdrawal times. Deposit limits, take-a-break settings and monthly activity statements remain where they were, in the account menu. Nyxa has also added deposit-limit information to the bet slip in a separate change.

How to update

The update is rolling out through the App Store and Google Play. Automatic updates will install it over the coming days; customers can also update manually from the store page. Version 4.12 requires iOS 14 or Android 7 and later.

The takeaway

If you use Nyxa on an older Android phone and the app has been crashing, update now. If you switch on biometric log-in, remember that faster access to the app is also a good reason to check your deposit limit.
